title: It is said that… / He is thought to…
summary: Безличные пассивные конструкции с глаголами речи и мнения (say, believe, think, report, expect, know...): модели It is said that… и He is said to be / to have been / to be doing, а также be supposed to.
ru:
## Две модели для «говорят, считается»
Когда мнение или информация принадлежит неопределённому кругу людей (СМИ, эксперты, общественность), английский использует пассив глаголов речи и мнения: **say, think, believe, know, understand, report, expect, consider, claim, allege, estimate, rumour, suppose, assume, fear**. Есть две равнозначные модели:
> **It is believed that** the painting is a forgery.
> The painting **is believed to be** a forgery. — Считается, что картина — подделка.
Вторая модель компактнее и характерна для новостей, юридических и научных текстов. Подлежащее придаточного (the painting) становится подлежащим всего предложения.

## Какой инфинитив поставить
Форма инфинитива показывает, **когда происходит действие** по отношению к моменту «считается»:
- **to + V** — то же время или будущее: He **is thought to live** in Prague. / The president **is expected to resign** next week.
- **to be + V-ing** — процесс идёт сейчас: The minister **is said to be negotiating** with the unions.
- **to have + V3** — раньше: The thief **is believed to have escaped** through the window.
- **to have been + V-ing** — длительность в прошлом: She **is thought to have been working** on the novel for years.
- **пассивный инфинитив**: The bridge **is expected to be completed** next year. / The vase **is known to have been stolen** twice.
Если глагол мнения в прошедшем, время сдвигается: He **was believed to be** dead (тогда так считали). / She **was said to have left** earlier.

## Есть ли ограничения по глаголам
Не все глаголы работают в обеих моделях. Только с **It + that-clause** употребляются **suggest, recommend, hope, decide, agree, announce, propose**: It **was announced that** the talks had failed. ~~The talks were announced to fail.~~ — Нельзя. Для **fear** возможна и короткая модель: The climbers **are feared dead** / **feared to have died**.
С **there**: There **is said to be** a secret passage under the castle. There **are thought to be** about 200 species on the island.

## be supposed to
Этот глагол в пассивной форме имеет три значения:
- **ожидание или долг**: You're **supposed to wear** a helmet. (правила требуют)
- **план**, который не выполнился: The train **was supposed to arrive** at nine, but it didn't.
- **репутация, «говорят»**: He's **supposed to be** a brilliant surgeon. — Он, говорят, блестящий хирург (но я не уверен).
Отрицание: You're **not supposed to park** here — запрещено.

## Стиль и осторожность
Структура позволяет **не называть источник** и сохранять дистанцию: The firm **is alleged to have misled** its customers. В судебной хронике и в журналистике так избегают прямого обвинения. В разговорной речи чаще скажут: *People say that…*, *They say…*

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~He is said that he is rich.~~ → He **is said to be** rich. / It **is said that** he is rich.
- ~~It is said him to be rich.~~ → He is said to be rich.
- ~~She is thought being a spy.~~ → She is thought **to be** a spy.
- ~~The thief is believed to escape yesterday.~~ → …**to have escaped** yesterday.
- ~~The merger was decided to go ahead.~~ → It **was decided that** the merger would go ahead.
en:
## Two patterns for «people say, it is believed»
When an opinion or a piece of news belongs to an unnamed group (the media, experts, the public), English uses the passive of reporting verbs: **say, think, believe, know, understand, report, expect, consider, claim, allege, estimate, suppose, fear**. There are two patterns:
> **It is believed that** the painting is a forgery.
> The painting **is believed to be** a forgery.
The second is shorter and typical of news, legal and academic writing.

## Which infinitive?
The infinitive shows the time of the event compared with the moment of the belief:
- **to + V** — same time or future: He **is thought to live** in Prague. The president **is expected to resign** next week.
- **to be + V-ing** — in progress: The minister **is said to be negotiating**.
- **to have + V3** — earlier: The thief **is believed to have escaped**.
- **to have been + V-ing** — duration up to now: She **is thought to have been working** on it for years.
- **passive infinitive**: The bridge **is expected to be completed** next year.
If the reporting verb is in the past, the time shifts: He **was believed to be** dead. She **was said to have left** earlier.

## Limits
Some verbs take only **It + that-clause**: **suggest, recommend, hope, decide, agree, announce, propose**. ~~The talks were announced to fail.~~ → It **was announced that** the talks had failed. With **fear** a short form is possible: The climbers **are feared dead**.
With **there**: There **is said to be** a secret passage. There **are thought to be** 200 species.

## be supposed to
- **duty or rule**: You're **supposed to wear** a helmet.
- **a plan that failed**: The train **was supposed to arrive** at nine (but it didn't).
- **reputation**: He's **supposed to be** a brilliant surgeon (people say so, but I am not sure).

## Style
The structure lets the writer **leave out the source**: The firm **is alleged to have misled** its customers. In conversation people more often say *They say…* or *People say that…*

## Common mistakes
- ~~He is said that he is rich.~~ → He **is said to be** rich.
- ~~She is thought being a spy.~~ → She is thought **to be** a spy.
- ~~The thief is believed to escape yesterday.~~ → …**to have escaped** yesterday.
structure:
## Две модели
| Модель | Формула | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| С it | It + be + V3 (reporting) + that + clause | It is said that he is wealthy. |
| С личным подлежащим | Subject + be + V3 + to-infinitive | He is said to be wealthy. |
| С there | There + be + V3 + to be | There is thought to be a flaw. |

## Выбор инфинитива
| Инфинитив | Значение | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| to + V | то же время / будущее | She is believed to live abroad. |
| to be + V-ing | идёт сейчас | They are said to be talking. |
| to have + V3 | раньше | He is thought to have left. |
| to have been + V-ing | длилось до сих пор | She is thought to have been lying. |
| to be / to have been + V3 | пассив | It is known to have been stolen. |

## Глаголы
| С обеими моделями | Только с it … that |
|---|---|
| say, think, believe, know, understand, report, expect, consider, claim, allege, estimate, suppose | suggest, recommend, hope, decide, agree, announce, propose |

## be supposed to
| Значение | Пример |
|---|---|
| Правило / долг | You're not supposed to park here. |
| Несостоявшийся план | The bus was supposed to leave at six. |
| Репутация | The film is supposed to be excellent. |

exercises.title: Какой инфинитив?
exercises.example: The thief is believed (escape) through a window. → The thief is believed **to have escaped** through a window.

items.text: The company is said {{to be}} in financial trouble.
The tunnel is expected {{to be opened}} by the mayor next spring.
She is thought {{to have left}} the country in 2019.
The two sides are reported {{to be negotiating}} at this very moment.
He is believed {{to have been working}} on the novel for a decade.
It is rumoured {{that}} the singer is about to retire.
The painting is known {{to have been stolen}} twice.
There are said {{to be}} over two hundred species of birds on the island.
The missing hikers are feared {{to have died}}.
At the time, the building {{was said}} to be the tallest in Europe.
She's supposed {{to be}} a brilliant surgeon, but I have never seen her operate.
You're not supposed {{to park}} here: it says so on the sign.
The driver was reported {{to have been injured}} in the crash.
Prices are expected {{to rise}} sharply over the next six months.

items.q: It is believed ___ the fire started in the kitchen.
items.why: Модель с it: **It is believed that + clause**.

items.q: The suspect is thought ___ the country last night.
The president is said ___ a statement at the moment.
items.why: at the moment — процесс идёт сейчас → **to be making**.

items.q: It ___ that talks will resume next week.
The company is understood ___ in talks to buy its rival.
items.why: Модель с личным подлежащим: **is understood to be**.

items.q: The new drug ___ to cause serious side effects.
items.why: Утверждает неопределённый круг лиц → пассив **is alleged to**.

items.q: You're not ___ to use your phone in the exam hall.
This restaurant is ___ to be the best in town, but I was disappointed.
items.why: Безличное «говорят» — **is said to be**; tell требует лица.

options: The minister is announced to resign.
It was announced that the minister would resign.

items.q: He is expected ___ the contract tomorrow.
В каком предложении событие произошло раньше?
options: He is said to live abroad.
He is said to have lived abroad.
He is said to be living abroad.

items.q: There ___ to be a serious flaw in the design.
items.why: flaw — единственное число: **is thought to be**.

exercises.title: Перепишите с личным подлежащим
exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение, начиная со слов после стрелки, и используйте пассив с to-infinitive.

items.prompt: People say that the owner is extremely wealthy. → The owner ...
answers: The owner is said to be extremely wealthy.

items.prompt: Experts believe that the virus originated in bats. → The virus ...
answers: The virus is believed to have originated in bats.

items.prompt: Journalists report that the minister is meeting union leaders. → The minister ...
answers: The minister is reported to be meeting union leaders.

items.prompt: Everyone expects that the bank will raise interest rates. → The bank ...
answers: The bank is expected to raise interest rates.

items.prompt: People thought that the island was uninhabited. → The island ...
answers: The island was thought to be uninhabited.

items.prompt: It is claimed that the company has cheated its customers for years. → The company ...
answers: The company is claimed to have cheated its customers for years.
The company is claimed to have been cheating its customers for years.

items.prompt: The factory is said to be closing. → It ...
answers: It is said that the factory is closing.
It's said that the factory is closing.
It is said the factory is closing.
It's said the factory is closing.

items.prompt: Говорят, что он живёт в Лондоне. (say) → He ...
answers: He is said to live in London.
He's said to live in London.

items.prompt: Считается, что картина была украдена в 1990 году. (believe) → The painting ...
answers: The painting is believed to have been stolen in 1990.

items.prompt: (there / think / be / a connection between the two cases) — Present, passive
answers: There is thought to be a connection between the two cases.

items.prompt: Ожидается, что цены вырастут. (expect / prices / rise)
answers: Prices are expected to rise.
It is expected that prices will rise.
It's expected that prices will rise.
It is expected prices will rise.
It's expected prices will rise.

items.prompt: It is believed that she has won a fortune. → She ...
answers: She is believed to have won a fortune.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями, используя конструкции юнита.

items.prompt: Чем славится ваш город или регион? (is said to be / is known for)
items.sample: My city is said to be one of the greenest in the region.

items.prompt: Что, как ожидается, скоро изменится в вашей стране? (is expected to)
items.sample: Public transport fares are expected to go up next year.

items.prompt: Что вы должны или не должны делать по правилам на работе или учёбе? (be supposed to)
items.sample: We are supposed to send the weekly report on Mondays.

items.prompt: Расскажите о недавней новости с «is reported to».
items.sample: The government is reported to be planning a new tax on cars.

items.prompt: Что, как говорят, было раньше в вашем районе? (is thought to have been)
items.sample: The old factory near my house is thought to have been a theatre in the 19th century.

items.prompt: Какая книга или фильм считаются шедеврами, но вам не понравились? (is considered to be)
items.sample: The film is considered to be a masterpiece, but I found it boring.
